Name: a2_prasc_theory_validation
Title: Auditable Rank, Bias and Acquisition Controls for Phase-Preserving Full-Wave Calibration
Short Hypothesis: The supplied fixed-tangent rank-loss, neutral-admission, bias-risk and shared-map innovation identities can be converted into checkable algorithm controls, while matched coherent-to-intensity information contracts. This is a validation work package, not an assumption of novelty or nonlinear method superiority.
Related Work: Projections, Schur complements, SOM/TSOM, coherent calibration, variable projection, source extension, continuation and experiment design are prior machinery. Idriss and Raj arXiv2503.07316 already jointly calibrate complex factors in multifrequency SOM. Retain this boundary; do not abandon the supplied validation task because ingredients are known.
Abstract: We implement falsification-first validation of A2 rank, bias and acquisition certificates. The exact physical state, independent free-current nuisance and numerical state approximation are different models. Small algebraic examples, exact induced intensity likelihoods and fixed physical tangents test conditional identities, their counterexamples and numerical failure modes. Results do not establish a universal basin, SOM exclusivity, hardware success or full-plan completion.
